title: Orbit benchmark scorecard (orbit.scorecard/1)
description: The scores of one Orbit version on one benchmark tier, stored per version so two scorecards can be compared (issue #172). The lab tier runs scenarios with fake providers and simulated spend; the live tier runs pinned goals with real providers, three times each, and keeps every result. A scenario whose own acceptance check is wrong is `invalid`: excluded from the rates, not counted as a failure. The headline carries the false-done rate (FR-007 of issue #172). Removing or retyping a field is a new version (orbit.scorecard/2) and a new schema.

without.description: The stages disabled for this run of the suite (`--without`); empty or absent when none was.

baseline.description: Whether the same goals were also attempted by one plain session (`--baseline`).

pass_rate.description: passed / runs; null when nothing was counted.

false_done_rate.description: The share of runs Orbit ended as delivered or done that were later found defective; null when none ended so.

cost_per_accepted_usd.description: Spend over accepted results; null when none was accepted or spend was not measured.

id.description: The scenario or goal, stable across versions so scorecards diff.

failure_class.description: A value of failure-class.schema.json for a result that failed; null otherwise.

spend_usd.description: Null when not measured; never 0 for unknown.

spend_simulated.description: True for the lab tier's simulated spend.

link.description: The hidden check, review finding, reopened issue or revert that found it.
